label: Bible Study
prompt: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he _____: and God saw that it was good.
verse: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.
note: Day three: God names the dry land and the gathered waters, then signs off with his favorite review — good.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But I have _____ for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
verse: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
note: Before Peter's denial, Jesus tells him: I've already prayed for thee — and when you turn back, strengthen the others.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the _____ of God.
verse: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.
note: The Ten Commandments came 'written with the finger of God' — Jesus used the same phrase for casting out devils in Luke 11:20.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And when the chief _____ shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.
verse: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.
note: Peter, once told 'Feed my sheep,' reminds the elders that they serve under the chief Shepherd.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Who is she that looketh forth as the morning, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, and _____ as an army with banners?
verse: Who is she that looketh forth as the morning, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, and terrible as an army with banners?
note: The beloved, fair as the moon and clear as the sun, is 'terrible as an army with banners' — awe-inspiring, not awful.
